title: Cut, Take, Raise
prompt: One thread, drawn cold, in three motions. Call what each motion leaves behind.

steps.note: split cuts on the spaces and hands back a list of threads.
Slot 0 — the front of the list, as always.
A new thread, raised. The old one is not touched.
Exactly as it began. Three motions, and the original was never once altered.

config.success: Split, taken, raised — and the first thread still whole. The loom only ever adds.
